t: In front of you is Rush of Green, a bronze group of a long-limbed family, father, mother, son and dog, rushing towards Hyde Park while the god Pan plays his pipes. It's also called Pan, or The Bowater House Group. It was the last sculpture Jacob Epstein completed before he died at home in Hyde Park Gate in August 1959, so it was cast in bronze after his death. It was installed in 1961 beneath Bowater House, removed when that was demolished in 2006, and put back near One Hyde Park in 2010. It has been Grade II listed since 2016.
